SELECT table_schema, table_name, (xpath('/row/cnt/text()', query_to_xml('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM ' || table_schema || '.' || table_name, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint as row_count
FROM information_schema.tables 
WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('information_schema', 'pg_catalog')
ORDER BY row_count DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20
